title: Jack Davison
text:
What I do


R package development I maintain {openair}, {openairmaps}, {worldmet} and {deweather}, and led the move of {openair} from lattice to ggplot2 in version 3.0. I also wrote {ukaq}, {euroaq} and {leaf.magic}, and I’ve had features merged into open source projects like {leaflet}, {dygraphs} and {prismatic}.
R · Git & GitHub · devtools · pkgdown · CRAN releases
Reproducible reporting Quarto reports that turn raw data into a polished output, whether ‘dynamic’ HTML dashboards or ‘static’ Typst-powered PDFs.
Quarto · R Markdown · Typst
Data visualisation Static and interactive graphics with ggplot2, plotnine, leaflet and gt. Runner-up and honourable mention in Posit Table and Data Visualisation Contests.
R · Python
Shiny apps Dashboards and internal tools for clients and colleagues.
Shiny for R · bslib
Teaching Posit Certified Tidyverse Instructor. I’ve designed workshops for and taught data analysis to learners from Defra, the Environment Agency, UKHSA, CASANZ, and the University of Gibraltar.
R · tidyverse

title: Jack Davison
text:
Selected work










{openair}



Software



The long-standing R toolkit for air quality analysis. Core maintainer; led openair 3.0, moving every plot from lattice to ggplot2.












{openairmaps}



Software



Lead developer. Combines openair’s analysis with interactive leaflet maps, most notably putting bivariate polar plots on maps for source triangulation.












{leaf.magic}



Software



Author. Builds customisable leaflet markers from modern icon libraries (Font Awesome, Bootstrap, Lucide, Ionicons) in any colour and size, with matching legends.












UK AIR Local Air Quality Dashboard



Apps



A public Shiny dashboard for Defra. Enter a postcode to see local monitoring, compliance and council action plans for any UK local authority.












YouGov Visualisations in Python



Data viz



Posit plotnine Contest 2025 entry: one-to-one recreations of YouGov political favourability graphics in Python with plotnine.












Tabulating DuBois



Data viz



Runner-up, Posit Table Contest 2022. Eight {gt} tables recreating the style and spirit of W.E.B. DuBois’ data visualisations.

title: Work
Work
text:
Reports & apps










UK AIR Local Air Quality Dashboard


A public Shiny dashboard for Defra. Enter a postcode to see local monitoring, compliance and council action plans for any UK local authority.












UK Hydrocarbons Network Annual Report 2024


A Quarto report published by Defra each year, summarising measurements of benzene and other VOCs and tracking compliance with the Air Quality Directive.












UK Summer 2023 Ozone Episode


A rapid-turnaround report on a protracted summer ozone episode, using then-new features in {gt} and {bslib}.












Air Quality on Bonfire Night 2023


Particulate pollution on Bonfire Night, and how well the Daily Air Quality Index works for short-lived events.












West London Particulate Episode 2023


An episode report with interactive leaflet maps, styled {gt} tables and {ggplot2} figures.

title: Work
text:
Teaching & talks










The openair book


Co-author, with Prof David Carslaw, of the free online guide to analysing air pollution data with R and the openair packages.












openair training courses


Co-tutor, with David Carslaw, of WSP’s online courses teaching air quality analysis in R to beginners.












University of Gibraltar R workshop


A two-day R workshop for environmental science master’s students at the University of Gibraltar, covering ggplot2, dplyr and R Markdown.












“Put it on a map!” Developments in air quality data analysis


A talk on {openairmaps} and modernising “legacy” R packages, given at satRdays London and the Oxford R User Group in 2023. Links to the recording.
